title: SLOT, Explained
subtitle: Casimir Beng and Osei Vandermeer on a car-park bonus that pays on how fast a disputed vacancy call is closed
summary: A research explainer from the School of Continuous Improvement on Casimir Beng and Osei Vandermeer's SLOT poster, an eighteen-week sensor deployment across ten car parks. It follows one disputed vacancy call from the bay's sensor to the duty officer's queue, then sets the fall in closure time once a bonus began paying on speed beside the accuracy of the calls themselves. Both authors describe the work in their own words.
topic: A research explainer of the SLOT poster, on how fast a car park's disputed vacancy calls were closed once the operator's bonus paid on closure speed rather than on whether the bay was actually free
